brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: Four bases placed as two vertical pairs: pair 1 at (0,0,0)+(0,0,1) joined by snap, pair 2 at (1,0,0)+(1,0,1) joined by snap. Horizontal adjacency only bridged by side connectors at level 0 (connector:0#0,0|1,0) and level 1 (connector:1#0,0|1,0) with no other horizontal piece adjacency beyond connectors.

finish.summary: Built two vertical stacks of two bases each, linked horizontally only by side connectors at both levels, satisfying brief. Mesh clear, no errors.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
